title: Client configuration | Driftwood Python SDK v3 (legacy)

title: Driftwood Python client times out after 60 seconds - Stack Overflow
description: My Driftwood Python client times out after 60 seconds on large exports. Answer: set request_timeout when creating the client, e.g. Client(request_timeout=300). The default request timeout is 60 seconds.
